title: eurybia viscosa
intro: Eurybia viscosa, commonly known as sticky eurybia, is a type of plant in the aster family (Asteraceae) that is native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eurybia viscosa include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
